spoken_summary: In an interview with Steve Bannon, a man says, "I have one ask for them. It's just when you give me my hood, make sure it's got the little slits and not the circles so I can see better." The comment is framed by on-screen text as a request for a 'KKK hood' and appears to be a racist joke referencing the speaker's own East Asian ethnicity.
